title: True Love's Caress

sources.title: Warding Bond
markers: target must be wearing the matching ring

summary: Lets the wearer receive Warding Bond from the matching ring.

fields.Warding Bond: Level 2 Action at melee range, once per Long Rest. The caster wears True Love’s Embrace and targets an ally wearing True Love’s Caress. The target resists all damage and gains +1 AC and saves. The caster takes corresponding damage after the target’s resistance and can reduce that damage with their own resistance. The redirected damage can trigger a Concentration save.
fields.Persistence: Lasts until Long Rest or caster death. Removing the rings or dismissing the caster to camp does not end the link. Reciprocal bonds cancel. A creature that has cast Warding Bond cannot receive its benefits.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
